decisions.reason: It builds closely on existing glass-silicon wafer and via capabilities, and own R&D with EU project links supports absorbing early results, so the firm can improve rather than drop it.
This carrier wafer is a straightforward extension of established carrier-wafer knowledge and fits the firm's move into reusable carriers, so related knowledge lets the firm interpret and refine it.
As a flagship copper interposer wafer close to existing glass wafer capabilities, the firm can leverage its R&D and materials know-how to assimilate results and improve the product.
The off-the-shelf brand is close to the firm's core glass and quartz wafer offer and is a stated focus, so existing knowledge supports learning and scale.

Because glass-based circuit boards are distant from the firm's existing wafer substrate knowledge and no related R&D or cooperation is indicated, the firm lacks the absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve the product.
